docs.title: toxindb
docs.text:
⚠️ EDUCATIONAL USE ONLY — AUTHORIZED TESTING ONLY.

RAG retrieval-time poisoning detector. Monitors retrieval demand, detects coordinated document clusters, plants canary claims, and enforces provenance attestation. Fully offline, deterministic, and evidence-first.

docs.title: Key Features
docs.text:
• 12 detection heuristics (TX-001–TX-012) for retrieval-time poisoning
  • Fully offline - zero network access by design
  • Deterministic - reproducible results
  • Evidence-first - SARIF, JSON, and Markdown reports
  • Library API - embed in your RAG pipelines
  • Configurable - tune thresholds without code changes

docs.title: Use Cases
docs.text:
• Security testing of RAG systems (with authorization)
  • Research and education on AI security
  • Defensive monitoring of retrieval patterns
  • Forensics and incident response

docs.title: API Reference
docs.text: See toxindb.api, toxindb.config, toxindb.sarif, and toxindb.webhooks modules for programmatic usage. All APIs are offline-first and deterministic.

docs.title: Benchmarks
docs.text: Benchmark samples are included in benchmarks/. The scaffolding supports PoisonedRAG/BEIR-style evaluations with TPR/FPR/ROC metrics.

docs.title: Installation
docs.text:
git clone https://github.com/5h4d0wn1k/toxindb.git
cd toxindb
pip install -e ".[dev]"

docs.title: CLI
docs.text:
toxindb monitor examples/traces/clean_trace.jsonl
toxindb canary --help
toxindb provenance examples/traces/clean_trace.jsonl
toxindb report examples/traces/poison_trace.jsonl
toxindb demo

docs.title: Python API
docs.text:
from toxindb import api, Trace

result = api.analyze_trace('examples/traces/poison_trace.jsonl')
print(f"Alerts: {result.alert_count}")

docs.title: Heuristics
docs.text:
toxindb implements 12 detection heuristics (TX-001 through TX-012) for retrieval-time poisoning detection:

  • TX-001: Demand Concentration
  • TX-002: Recency Anomaly
  • TX-003: Embedding Cluster
  • TX-004: Canary Resurgence
  • TX-005: Provenance Mismatch
  • TX-006: Bulk-Ingest Pulse
  • TX-007: Query-Doc Mismatch
  • TX-008: Double Retrieval
  • TX-009: Source Cartel
  • TX-010: Drifted Authority
  • TX-011: New-Namespace Flash
  • TX-012: Quarantine

docs.title: Security & Ethics
docs.text: This tool is for authorized security testing only. Unauthorized use is prohibited and may be illegal. See ETHICS.md and SCOPE.md.
